symptom: i2cdetect returns a single device at 0x68 but my MPU6050 code reads all zeros

files.mpu.py:
from board import *
from adafruit_mpu6050 import MPU6050
i2c = I2C(scl, sda)
mpu = MPU6050(i2c)
print(mpu.acceleration)

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the device at 0x68 (104) — the MPU6050's address. The adafruit_mpu6050 driver defaults to 0x68, but without passing it explicitly some board revisions mis-target during the library's probe and read zeros. Pass address=0x68 to the constructor explicitly.
